verdicts.title: On kernel-based estimation of conditional Kendall's tau: finite-distance bounds and asymptotic behavior
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study nonparametric estimators of conditional Kendall's tau, a measure of concordance between two random variables given some covariates. We prove non-asymptotic bounds with explicit constants, that hold with high probabilities. We provide "direct proofs" of the consistency and the asymptotic law of conditional Kendall's tau. A simulation study evaluates the numerical performance of such nonparametric estimators.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns 'nonparametric estimators of conditional Kendall's tau' as a measure of concordance with covariates, which shares only the Kendall tau vocabulary but does not address resolution proof complexity or literal frequency distributions in 3-CNF instances.
